description: Fetch mail messages received since a given timestamp. Prerequisite: you are online on the city server (always true for the live bot). Effect: sends a MailRequest{Type=POLL_INBOX, TimestampID=<100ns ticks>} on the city Aries socket; the server's MailHandler replies with MailResponse{Type=POLL_RESPONSE, Messages=[...]}. Each message carries id (db message_id), sender_persist_id, sender_name, subject, body, time (100ns ticks), type/subtype, read_state. The poll is strictly server-driven — read_state does not transition here (there is NO server PDU to mark-read on this fork; read_state is a DB column writable only on INSERT). Cost: zero in-world currency. Server caps subject to 128 chars and body to 1500 chars at INSERT time; stored bodies are BB-sanitised. Real-time inbound mail also surfaces via the same MailResponse path (Type=NEW_MAIL) pushed when the sender is online.

args.name: since_ticks
args.description: Poll cut-off in .NET DateTime ticks (100-nanosecond intervals since 0001-01-01 UTC). Messages with time > since_ticks are returned. Default 0 → returns the full inbox. The InboxController's pattern is to pass the most-recently-received message's time on subsequent polls so you only get new mail; passing 0 always returns the full inbox and is fine for low-volume agent use.

call_signatures: cf $CF poll-inbox                                                                                        # since_ticks defaults to 0 → full inbox
cf $CF poll-inbox --since_ticks <last_message_time_ticks>                                                # only new messages since that .NET-ticks time
common_mistakes: Another poll-inbox already in flight → ok:false (single-slot correlator).
since_ticks < 0 → ok:false; 0 returns the full inbox.
since_ticks uses .NET DateTime ticks (100ns since 0001-01-01 UTC), not Unix seconds.
perception_hints: Your own persist_id (for self-send health check): perception.avatar.persist_id
Inbound NEW_MAIL pushes surface in perception.recent_events[] with kind=='mail', direction=='in' — the extras carry mail_id / sender_persist_id / subject
Target persist_id: perception.nearby_sims[].persist_id (on-lot) or from your remembered contacts
refuse_conditions: since_ticks not an integer or < 0 → ok:false
another poll-inbox in flight → ok:false (single-slot correlator)
